keyParity: 100% — every key in en.json is present in hi.json
scope: Covers the i18n surface area used by the persistent UI chrome (nav, support panel, age attestation, declaration label, emergency labels). The redesigned marketing pages — homepage, /how-it-works, /resources, /faq, /privacy, /contact, /terms, /feedback, /start, /minor-support, victim flow, admin console — render English-primary copy directly in JSX and do NOT pull from this dictionary.
notes: AI-drafted Hindi strings. Do not mark production-ready until reviewed by a native Hindi speaker for trauma-informed tone, gender-inclusive verb forms, and legal-citation accuracy. A separate translation pass is required for the marketing-copy on the redesigned pages — see asmita/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-17-homepage-redesign-design.md section 14.5.
policyOnGenderInclusiveForms: Verb forms use both feminine and masculine endings (e.g., 'करती/करता हूं') to avoid presuming the survivor's gender. Keep this pattern in future translations.
